script: This invisible force powers your daily life, and you don't even know it. It's called Data Science. Every time you stream a movie, unlock your phone, or see a targeted ad, you're interacting with it. Data Science is the art of extracting insights from massive amounts of information. Think about it: every click, every purchase, every search creates data. Data scientists collect this raw information, clean it up, and then use powerful algorithms to find hidden patterns. This helps companies predict trends, personalize your experiences, and even design better products. From predicting the weather to powering self-driving cars, Data Science is silently at work. It's the silent engine behind so much of modern life, constantly shaping your world with this invisible force.
